description: Matched CPU physics benchmarks for EERSim 0.1.12 native sleeping.
limits: CPU physics on a shared A100 host; GPUs, rendering, GUI, replay and tensor cores were not used.
Timing excludes world construction and separate observation/diagnostic queries. Window durations use per-tick CSV measurements.
Passive smoke checks validate finite state and fixed clocks, not autonomous placement. Full native claw cases use unchanged PROS source and strict physical lift/place/retreat checks.
The release baseline differs only by the same read-only benchmark-tool overlay used for the candidate. Candidate additionally contains the two listed frozen physics files.
Matching rate, scene and iteration counts does not establish trajectory equivalence or identical solver accuracy across engines.
Sleeping trees are MuJoCo counters; PhysX reports ordinary dynamic actors and articulations separately. Those counts are not interchangeable.
Results are individual sequential runs, not confidence intervals; another machine or scene can differ.
